title: Audio Reactive Scene
user: Indie site owners, streamers, and event makers who want a tasteful, controllable audio-reactive visual scene without recording visitors or embedding a heavy visualiser product.
smallest_useful_product: A copyable web component with three local canvas scenes, Web Audio analyser input, motion-reduction mode, manual intensity controls, and static poster fallback.
constraints: Audio and microphone activation require a user gesture; honour prefers-reduced-motion; ship only original visuals and sounds.
